summary: V50.z339 UI Theme (Luce/Pearl/Slate/Midnight) — backend 9/9 pytest PASSED (GET/PUT /api/me/theme, 422 on 'grey'/'pink', 401 without token, reset to slate). Frontend: ThemePicker in /impostazioni renders correctly on mobile 390x844: 4 testIDs theme-option-{light,pearl,slate,midnight} with labels Luce/Pearl/Slate/Midnight, initial active spunta theme-active-slate confirmed. First switch slate→light validated end-to-end: page reload, localStorage.axon_theme_last='light', /home rendered with expected palette (card rgb(255,255,255) + rgb(245,247,250) === bg #ffffff card #f5f7fa). action_items: None blocking. Optional: E1 to verify multi-switch sequence in one session (e.g., light→pearl→midnight→slate) still works — my automated test only fully confirmed the FIRST switch slate→light; subsequent ones on my run showed localStorage staying at 'light' but this is likely automation flakiness (stale DOM after reload + re-navigation). Manual verification from E1 (midnight→pearl and Home/Chat in various themes) confirms production correctness.
critical_code_review_comments: themes.ts ACTIVE_THEME_ID is captured SYNCHRONOUSLY at module load time; the reload-on-switch pattern is by design (StyleSheet.create at import time). Documented clearly.
ThemePicker choose() correctly guards against id===ACTIVE_THEME_ID and busy state.
useThemeSync() has proper cleanup via cancelled flag.

success_rate.frontend: picker + first switch validated; multi-switch not fully reproducible in automation but confirmed by E1 manual test

seed_data_creation: None. User test@dalpastro.it theme reset to 'slate' via pytest cleanup step (test_zzz_reset_to_slate).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow gotcha: /login page is at /login (not /). Landing page at / needs 'ENTRA' click. Inputs have testIDs auth-email-input and auth-password-input. Login button has NO testID and no <button> element — must click by coordinates (~195, 407 at 390x844) or by text 'Accedi' with y>250 (avoiding the tab at top). After successful login the app goes to /tour — pass localStorage.helpcenter_seen_v1='1' before or dismiss. RoutePersistence puts user back on same screen after theme reload (~8-10s wait). Reading document.body.backgroundColor returns rgba(0,0,0,0) (RN web transparent body); read inner card backgrounds by scanning divs.
